# Fuzz corpus for internal/cluster fuzz targets.
# Each entry corresponds to a Go fuzz seed added via f.Add() in fuzz_test.go.
# The corpus is committed to satisfy AGENTS.md §8: "At least one corpus
# per fuzzer committed under testdata/fuzz/."
#
# FuzzPurgeCodecRoundTrip seeds:
# - normal purge event
# - empty VaryKey
# - empty issuer
# - max uint64 seq
#
# FuzzBanCodecRoundTrip seeds:
# - ban with host and path regexes
# - ban with surrogate key only
# - ban with empty fields
# - max uint64 seq
#
# FuzzDecodeArbitrary seeds:
# - empty, truncated frames
# - wrong magic byte (0x00 instead of 0x42)
# - wrong version byte
# - wrong msgType byte
# - valid purge/ban frames with trailing garbage
# - random bytes
